text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: Did you have a good day off?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I served Irish black tea to my friends,
and we cooked traditional dishes together~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The colcannon I made was a huge hit!
Next time, I'll make some for you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite used to cooking yet,
but I can serve this with total confidence!
choice_data_list: If you get the chance, definitely.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's a promise then♪
Tell me what you think after you eat it, okay!
